app.title: Dropbeam
app.tagline: Send files straight between your devices. Nothing is uploaded.
help.title: How it works
help.diagram: Two devices pair with a QR code, check three words, then send files directly.
help.step1.title: Start on one device
help.step1.body: Tap Start. Dropbeam makes a short code and shows it as a QR tile.
help.step2.title: Join from the other device
help.step2.body: Scan the code with the other device, or open its link to pair.
help.step3.title: Check the three words
help.step3.body: Both screens show the same three words. If they differ, disconnect and start again.
help.step4.title: Drop files or type a note
help.step4.body: Files travel directly between the two devices. Nothing is uploaded.
ts.title: Troubleshooting
ts.sameWifi.title: Both devices on the same Wi-Fi
ts.sameWifi.body: Both devices must be on one network: join the same Wi-Fi and start again. A hotspot or guest Wi-Fi counts as its own network.
ts.isolation.title: Guest networks and AP isolation
ts.isolation.body: Some routers isolate guest-network devices from each other (AP isolation). Use the main network, or try the hotspot trick.
ts.vpn.title: VPN
ts.vpn.body: A VPN can hide the local network. Pause it while pairing, then turn it back on.
ts.hotspot.title: Hotspot trick
ts.hotspot.body: Connect the other device to this phone's hotspot and pair as usual. This gets past a router that isolates its clients.
ts.stun.title: Across networks (STUN)
ts.stun.body: STUN asks a public server for your public address so devices on different networks can meet. That server sees your IP. Off by default.
ts.browsers.title: Browser support
selftest.title: Connection test
selftest.lead: Two peers meet inside this tab; nothing leaves your device. A pass means this browser can open direct connections.
selftest.pass: Pass. A direct connection opened in {ms} ms.
selftest.err.unsupported: This browser doesn't support direct connections (WebRTC).
selftest.err.connecting: The connection could not be established. Try again, or read the troubleshooting page.
share.title: Ready to send
share.hint: Pair a device to send them.
share.sendFailed: Couldn't send the shared files automatically. Pair again to retry.
idle.title: Dropbeam
idle.lead: Move files between your own devices, over a direct connection. No account, no upload, no server.
debug.title: Debug panel
debug.hint: Opened with the developer gesture: eight taps on the right edge of the screen.
pair.title: Pairing
pair.scanOffer: Scan the other device's QR code
pair.waitingReply: Waiting for the other device to scan or paste its reply…
pair.noWebcam: No camera here? Ask the other device to share its reply link and open it on this one.
connect.title: Connecting
connect.working: Connecting directly to the other device…
connect.approveBody: No files can move until you allow it. Check the verification words match if you recognise this device.
connect.pendingApproval: Waiting for you to allow this connection.
connect.verifiedHelp: The words match on both devices.
transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.verificationHelp: Check that both devices show the same words. If they differ, disconnect.
settings.title: Settings
settings.autoAcceptHelp: Saves a step, but anyone who can scan your code can send to you.
settings.stunHelp: Uses a public STUN server to discover your public address. Your IP is disclosed to that server. Off by default.
err.CAMERA_DENIED: Camera blocked. Paste the code instead or allow camera in settings.
err.CODE_INVALID: That doesn't look like a Dropbeam code.
err.ICE_GATHER_TIMEOUT: Couldn't find a network path. Check Wi-Fi.
err.CONNECT_TIMEOUT: Couldn't connect. Same Wi-Fi? Try hotspot or Across networks.
err.HASH_MISMATCH: File arrived damaged. Try sending again.
err.SINK_UNAVAILABLE: Your browser can't save files this big.
err.UNSUPPORTED: This browser can't do direct transfers.
